published_prior_art.cite: HanShah2025SSC gives finite-sample SSC consistency; DoblerPaulyScheike2019 gives multiplier bands in Cox/multistate survival models, but neither proves patient-level multiplier validity through censored functional PCR for a missing causal curve.
CattaneoFengTitiunik2021 separates scalar synthetic-control uncertainty sources, but has neither a censored functional Le Cam subexperiment nor the exact-rank-one normalization degeneration.
HanShah2025SSC identifies and gives finite-grid consistency for SSC; no verified cited result gives the matched continuous-time minimax width transition between exact ranks one and at least two.

CarpentierKloppLofflerNickl2018 links honest low-rank adaptation to composite testing for matrix completion, not censored causal survival-curve bands with normalization-induced oracle-width discontinuity.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:sharp-rank-frontier / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The frontier is conditional on known fixed exact rank, uniform contrast and pre-Gram strength, independent censoring, and the stated fixed-horizon survival class.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The claimed sharp rates are minimax rates within the conditional classes P_r(N0,KT,KD), not adaptive or approximate-rank guarantees.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.4 and Appendix E, especially the target definition, row-space inclusion, and equations (72)–(73) decomposition
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies the post-control survival target under a low-rank survival-factor model and derives finite-sample SSC consistency through a PCR decomposition; the inspected material contains no simultaneous-band or minimax-width theorem.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Machine Learning Research 26 (2025), paper 23-0102
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies the unique minimum-l2-norm PCR coefficient and gives in- and out-of-sample PCR error bounds under balanced-spectrum and row-space inclusion conditions.
The article develops martingale-based resampling for asymptotically valid time-simultaneous confidence bands for cumulative hazards in Cox and multistate models, with survival-function applications.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 116(536), 2021 author-hosted publication PDF
source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 11, Lemma 1 and surrounding discussion; p. 30 conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Lemma 1 combines the pre-treatment weight-estimation and post-treatment prediction-error terms into conditional prediction intervals; the paper explicitly describes these as two uncertainty sources.
The article formalizes honest adaptive confidence sets through a composite low-rank testing problem and gives impossibility and constructive-testing results for matrix completion.
The paper studies synthetic-control inference under factor confounding and states that the relevant sources of randomness depend on the confounding configuration.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a corollary that gives a precise validity or undercoverage frontier for the donor-only PETAL bootstrap relative to the patient-multiplier band, including a normalization-preserving rank-at-least-two sequence.

Turn the unknown-rank OEQ into a two-sided testing theorem: state an explicit separation scale for the second normalized singular value and pair any attainable excess-width result with a matching impossibility lower bound.
Add an approximate-rank extension with a named, observable sup-norm projection-residual modulus and a matching bias-aware band, so the exact-rank frontier has a practical robustness boundary.

recommended_next_step: Advance the exact-rank minimax frontier to Stage 0 while retaining unknown-rank adaptation and approximate-rank robustness as distinct follow-on targets.
